content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple's newest product officially began taking pre-orders this morning, and major brands are already ready. Apple has rolled out a vibrant lineup of silicone cases, brand-new TechWoven fabric cases, and classic designs from several top third-party makers. From a new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to ultra-personalized models with a fantastic in-hand feel, to premium leather options from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods — there's something for everyone. Brands like Spigen also offer budget-friendly choices starting from $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's brand-new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has officially arrived, offering premium colorways and patented technologies. The standout is the all-new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, featuring a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand that seamlessly merges with the camera bump for added protection, reportedly delivering 3x military-grade protection while being "soft, flexible, and comfortable to the touch." The new Atelier collection comes in four colorways, with extra accessories to complement the new burgundy, ice blue, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand Case with Anti-Slip Grip: $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad, the well-known premium leather case brand, has its full lineup of cases ready for all iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship models. The brand has also introduced a brand-new Rugged Case series this year, with each colorway featuring a textured contour inspired by the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather Case: $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Color: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand's hugely popular Grip Case is ready to support iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs and an ultra-grippy feel, it continues to offer full custom skin support this year, letting you add a personal touch; pair it with a Prism screen protector and you'll also get a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $55. Customizable, drop-proof, ultra-grippy, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: $35 ($5 off when purchased with a case). Easy installation, auto-alignment, and fully dust-proof.

Dbrand has also launched an all-new MNML case series this year, starting from $39, focusing on minimalist stylish design and affordable pricing, retaining MagSafe support while keeping the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colors: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max, Black): $19 (originally $40)

Arc's 2026 Pulse aviation-grade metal bumper case has arrived, with several new colors this year to complement Apple's Ice Blue and Burgundy phones:

  • Matte Black — $69.99

  • Matte Deep Red — $119.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 Series): $59
  • Colors: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • Modular Case (iPhone 18 Series): $59
  • The detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With the back panel attached: it's a slim full-grain leather MagSafe-compatible case.

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive promo code 9TO520 at checkout for an additional 20% off the already reduced launch price (applies to the cases below). If the code doesn't work, try DUO10.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $60 (originally $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $89 (originally $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): $60 (originally $80)

UAG

UAG also offers a lineup of cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring the brand's signature reinforced corners, anti-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you're looking for a case that can withstand harsh conditions while still being suitable for everyday protection, the UAG lineup is well worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro & 18 Pro Max): $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want a rugged case for your new phone but don't like the usual brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is well worth considering. These cases have passed MIL-STD-810H drop testing, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case without making your phone too bulky, Mous is a solid choice. Mous now offers ultra-thin aramid fiber cases for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fiber Case: $70
  • More…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for futuristic design, edgy style, and slim profiles, standing out with unique textured finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Proof Case (iPhone 18 Pro): $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking an ultra-thin design. Their products are typically made from lightweight aramid fiber, with a clean, understated look, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and offering extra protection at the camera and bumper areas.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop-Proof Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse selection of cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs, providing reliable protection. Many new models support MagSafe, and some even feature grippier edges, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More…

Belkin

Belkin is another reliable choice for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially for users who prefer a clean style, don't want to make their phone too bulky, but also don't need a military-grade case. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised screen and camera edges, and some models (like Protect+) even add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Anti-Slip Grip: $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: $60
